title: Solved: Deleted account continues to prompt ""Mozilla Thunderbird Email wants access to your Google Account"
creator: bruce.jane.fraser
content:
This is not a question, but rather the solution I found. Sorry if I'm posting in the wrong place, but I couldn't find a better place.

THE PROBLEM I deleted an account. But every time I start Thunderbird, this message pops up in Firefox browser: "Mozilla Thunderbird Email wants access to your Google Account" -- and it's for the deleted account!

I tried all the suggestions I found on the internet, but none of them solved it:

  • Add the account again, then delete again
  • In Thunderbird Settings - Privacy and Security - Saved Passwords: delete anything with that name
  • In Account Settings - Outgoing Server: delete anything with that name
  • Calendar: delete anything with that name

Finally, one more thing did it:

  • Address book: delete anything with that name;
  • even delete address book with no name. Aha! It was this last step that did it.
